title: Three-step process for the synthesis of 10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepin-10-ol derivatives
content:

We reported the synthesis of 10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepin-10-ol derivatives, a class of compounds that has been limitedly investigated in the literature.
